title: OntoFuel NVL Ontology Data Contract
description: Versioned, provenance-bearing contract for OntoFuel Neo4j-NVL ontology visualization data (NFM-227 / NFM-226 ADR D2). The nodes/relationships element structure is unchanged from the legacy {nodes, relationships} shape; this schema only adds version + provenance + stats envelope and pins the element field constraints.

schema_version.description: Contract semantic version. Initial value '1.0'. Allows major.minor or full major.minor.patch.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC) when the NVL artifact was generated.

source_ontology.description: Path or identifier of the canonical ontology JSON the artifact was derived from.

source_digest.description: Short sha256 digest (first 16 hex chars) of the canonical ontology serialization, for provenance / drift detection.

stats.description: NVL-derived counts. classes/individuals count NVL nodes of each type (classes includes converter-generated placeholder class nodes, so may exceed the source class count).

nodes.description: Graph nodes. Element shape unchanged from legacy NVL; type is controlled to class|individual.

relationships.description: Graph relationships. Element shape unchanged from legacy NVL.

id.description: Stable node id, referenced by relationship.from/to.

class.description: For individuals: the class this individual instantiates.

relationship.$comment: type is intentionally permissive (string, minLength 1): it MUST accept INSTANCE_OF, SUBCLASS_OF, and any domain verb (object property name). Enumerating verbs would falsely reject valid future properties.

type.description: Relationship type: INSTANCE_OF | SUBCLASS_OF | domain verb (object property name).
